close_reason: valid P3 RFC 8620 §5.3 inconsistency; deferring to post-publish pass
description: Identity/set (identity.rs) correctly returns invalidArguments for the whole request if any element in the destroy array is not a string, per RFC 8620 §5.3. All other set handlers (ban.rs, message.rs, emoji.rs, position.rs, chat.rs, etc.) silently skip non-string destroy elements with 'continue'. The lenient behavior is not spec-compliant. This is a minor correctness issue — a real JMAP client should never send non-string IDs, but the inconsistency could mask client bugs. Consistent behavior should be chosen.
title: destroy-array validation inconsistent: RFC 8620 §5.3 non-string element handling
